687-2034-4613-8130-8132.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-2034-4613-8130-8132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Easterling Vanguard.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-2034-4613-8130-8132.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {1} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

856-5220-6495-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5220-6495-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5220-6495-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

2292-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-2412-6972.description:
Activate Crosis's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Crosis's Attendant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

2757-7495-7498.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Skycoach Conductor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Biblioplex Tomekeeper, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1661-3713-4474-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1978-3053-4324.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-4324.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Workshop Elders.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1414-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2707-5751-6259-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

198-3525-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding {U} for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1329-2178-4487.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-4487.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Emry triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1550-1879-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-1879-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-803-1849-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-1849-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1817-2829-5365.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{G/U}{G/U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1817-2829-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-2829-5365.description:
Cast Lonis either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-2829-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

240-526-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
240-526-2438.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

2511-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
2511-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1164-2003-2056-2631.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Alrund's Epiphany was foretold.
1164-2003-2056-2631.description:
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {6} and tapping it, putting two loyalty counters on Saheeli.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Alrund's Epiphany and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Alrund's Epiphany being the top most card.
Move to your next turn, drawing Alrund's Epiphany during your draw step.
Repeat.

184-3809-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-3809-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

824-2464-3129.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2464-3129.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from target creature and putting two +1/+1 counters on a different creature due to Primal Vigor.
Repeat.

396-1409-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1409-4050-4772.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

942-2523-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise, adding one mana of any color.
When Samwise dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one applicable card from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return and cast Samwise infinite times to get an infinitely large storm count.

2178-2348-4481.notablePrerequisites: Heavy Arbalest and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature you control without summoning sickness.
2178-2348-4481.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
Activate the creature with Heavy Arbalest and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat as desired for each land an opponent controls, and whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

734-1526-4499-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
734-1526-4499-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Bristling Hydra.
Bristling Hydra enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Lightning Runner ability from step 1, causing you to get {E}{E}, then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1371-1827-3765-5049.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Vampiric Tutor.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Vampiric Tutor, causing them to search their library for a card, put it on top of their library and lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

467-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-2178-4050.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Thornbite Staff's equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to Shorikai.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pilot, adding one mana of any color.
Shorikai triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2427-2556.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1860-2686-4274.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Barren Glory by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Resolve Barren Glory.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

890-1247-1656.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
890-1247-1656.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Palladium Myr's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
